title: Improving the Logistic Regression Model through Hyperparameter Selection

cues.en: Welcome to Section three Training, a supervised learning model.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到第三章：訓練監督式學習模型。

cues.en: This is Lecture nine Improving the logistic regression model through hyper parameter selection.
cues.zh: 這是第九堂課：透過超參數選擇來改善邏輯斯迴歸模型。

cues.en: So to kick off where we were last time, we trained a simple logistic regression model.
cues.zh: 先回顧上一堂課，我們訓練了一個簡單的邏輯斯迴歸模型。

cues.en: We evaluated the effectiveness of that model on the test set, made predictions on the test set, and
cues.zh: 在測試集上做預測、評估模型的成效，並且

cues.en: we produced a confusion matrix to see how well the model fared in terms of detecting fraudulent cases
cues.zh: 產生混淆矩陣，看看模型偵測詐欺案例的表現，

cues.en: and how many false positives, etcetera it determined.
cues.zh: 以及產生了多少偽陽性等資訊。

cues.en: So that was a baseline solution.
cues.zh: 那是一個基準方案。

cues.en: The second implementation that I've coded up in my cell includes one hyper parameter, which is the
cues.zh: 我在下一個程式儲存格中加入了一個超參數，

cues.en: class weights and hyper parameters are things that you could tune on the model itself.
cues.zh: 也就是 class_weight。超參數是可以針對模型本身調整的設定。

cues.en: So you can think of them as knobs or buttons that you can tune in relation to one another to help the
cues.zh: 你可以把它們想成旋鈕或按鈕，透過彼此搭配調整，來幫助

cues.en: model generalize better, to help the model train better to reduce overfitting.
cues.zh: 模型改善泛化、改善訓練，並降低過度擬合。

cues.en: There's different type of parameters.
cues.zh: 參數有不同類型。

cues.en: Every model has its own unique set of hyper parameters or algorithm has its own set of hyper parameters and in the imbalanced.
cues.zh: 每一種模型或演算法都有自己的一組超參數。而在

cues.en: Um, class issue.
cues.zh: 類別不平衡的問題中，

cues.en: Typically balancing out the class weights is one of the most important hyper parameters I found.
cues.zh: 我發現平衡類別權重，通常是最重要的超參數設定之一。

cues.en: So with the logistic regression implementation in scikit learn it makes sense to pay attention to that hyper parameter.
cues.zh: 因此，使用 scikit-learn 的邏輯斯迴歸時，很值得留意這個超參數。

cues.en: Um, I mean there are hyper parameters that you can implement to reduce overfitting as well.
cues.zh: 當然，也有其他超參數可以降低過度擬合。

cues.en: But in this case what we want to focus on first is just paying attention to the minority class first.
cues.zh: 但目前，我們先把重點放在讓模型關注少數類別。

cues.en: So what this effectively does is it balances out the how the model gets penalized at training time.
cues.zh: 這個設定實際上會平衡模型在訓練時受到的懲罰。

cues.en: So it's effectively telling the model, pay attention to the minority class in more detail, but it's doing that automatically by balancing out.
cues.zh: 等於告訴模型要更仔細留意少數類別，而且會自動依照

cues.en: How the model gets penalized based on the proportion of labels within each of the classes.
cues.zh: 各類別的標籤比例，調整模型受到的懲罰。

cues.en: So if there's a, you know, a 100 to 1 ratio between the majority class and the minority class, this
cues.zh: 例如，多數類別與少數類別的比例是 100 比 1，這個設定

cues.en: would effectively overweigh the minority class by a factor of 100.
cues.zh: 就會讓少數類別的權重提高 100 倍。

cues.en: So it does that automatically just based on the the nature of the imbalance.
cues.zh: 它會根據不平衡的程度自動進行調整。

cues.en: And then once we've done that, we can just retrain the model, make the predictions, and then report on the confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 設定完成後，就重新訓練模型、做出預測，再輸出混淆矩陣。

cues.en: And this is what we see.
cues.zh: 這就是結果。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So if you remember from the previous lecture, we had fewer.
cues.zh: 如果還記得上一堂課，我們當時的

cues.en: True positives.
cues.zh: 真陽性比較少。

cues.en: So fraudulent cases that were detected and we only had six false positives.
cues.zh: 也就是偵測到的詐欺案例較少，而偽陽性只有六筆。

cues.en: So we've got far more false positives now, which is a bit on the problematic side.
cues.zh: 現在偽陽性多了很多，這就有點問題。

cues.en: So we've been able to detect a lot more fraud, which is good, but at the same time we've, you know, misclassified a lot more good customers, which is not a good thing.
cues.zh: 我們偵測到了更多詐欺，這很好，但同時也把更多正常客戶分錯，這並不是好事。

cues.en: So what we want to do is try and balance that out and you can take a cost based approach, which is something that we will explore later where, you know, the these additional false positives, if you
cues.zh: 因此，我們要設法取得平衡。後面會介紹以成本為基礎的方法，也就是對額外增加的偽陽性，

cues.en: apply a cost to each of these misclassifications, you know, the cost might be small, there might be a slight.
cues.zh: 以及每一次錯誤分類都指定成本。單筆成本可能不高，可能只是些微的

cues.en: Reputational cost with your customers, they might have a bad experience.
cues.zh: 客戶聲譽成本，例如讓客戶有了不好的體驗。

cues.en: There might be some operational overhead from an analyst or somebody who has to flag this as an incorrect classification and so on.
cues.zh: 也可能增加分析人員的作業負擔，必須把這些案例標示為錯誤分類等等。

cues.en: But the cost is usually quite small per unit.
cues.zh: 但每一筆的成本通常都不高。

cues.en: But you know, it adds up if you've got 700 of them, right.
cues.zh: 不過，如果有 700 筆，加起來就很可觀了。

cues.en: Then from a fraud perspective, we've now caught, you know, far more fraud than we did in the previous section.
cues.zh: 從詐欺的角度看，現在抓到的案例，也比上一堂課多得多。

cues.en: And fraud carries the highest cost generally in these problems.
cues.zh: 而在這類問題中，詐欺通常造成最高的成本。

cues.en: So, you know, that's the point of what we're trying to do.
cues.zh: 所以，這正是我們努力的目標。

cues.en: We're trying to detect fraud while keeping our number of false positives reasonably low.
cues.zh: 在讓偽陽性數量維持合理低水準的同時，盡量偵測出詐欺。

cues.en: So if you know, a cost per misclassification here would be, for example, $10.
cues.zh: 例如，這裡每次錯誤分類的成本可能是 10 美元。

cues.en: Just as a simple example, the cost of missing a fraudulent transaction might be, you know, $100 or
cues.zh: 舉個簡單的例子，漏掉一筆詐欺交易的成本，可能是 100 美元或

cues.en: $1000 depending on what the average fraudulent amount is within the ecosystem, which is why it's just
cues.zh: 1,000 美元，取決於系統中詐欺交易的平均金額。因此，光是

cues.en: looking at the absolute magnitude of the Misclassifications doesn't always tell you the full picture.
cues.zh: 查看錯誤分類的絕對數量，往往無法看出全貌。

cues.en: You also want to take a cost base approach and then see, well, maybe it's actually worthwhile if we're catching, you know, ten more fraudsters and increasing the number of false positives.
cues.zh: 還應該採用成本角度來評估；如果多抓到十名詐欺者，即使增加了偽陽性，或許仍然值得。

cues.en: That's it's a possibility.
cues.zh: 這確實是有可能的。

cues.en: It's something just to consider.
cues.zh: 值得納入考量。

cues.en: And then we've plotted it out again using Matplotlib and Seaborn, which looks really nice.
cues.zh: 接著，我們再次使用 Matplotlib 與 Seaborn 繪圖，呈現效果很好。

cues.en: Then as a second model, to try and improve on this first one that we've created, I've introduced a
cues.zh: 為了改善第一個模型，我又建立了第二個模型，採取

cues.en: more granular attempt at rebalancing the class weights.
cues.zh: 更細緻的方式來重新平衡類別權重。

cues.en: So instead of taking the default balanced approach where it just automatically, you know, re weights it based on the the proportions of each of the classes here.
cues.zh: 不再使用預設的 balanced，讓模型單純依各類別的比例自動調整權重。

cues.en: I've explicitly said, well, for the minority class, keep it as is, or rather for the majority class, keep it as is.
cues.zh: 而是明確指定，少數類別保持原樣，不對，應該是多數類別保持原樣。

cues.en: But for the minority class, you know, increase the emphasis on that class by 50, for example, which
cues.zh: 少數類別則例如提高為 50 倍的權重，

cues.en: is less than if it was 100 to 1.
cues.zh: 這比 100 比 1 時自動給予的權重更低。

cues.en: So that's effectively saying, well, pay attention to that class, but not as much as you did in the case where we used the balanced value for the class weight hyper parameter.
cues.zh: 意思就是，仍然要關注這個類別，但不像 class_weight 設為 balanced 時那麼強烈。

cues.en: And then I can retrain the model based on that and then reproduce the confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 接著依此重新訓練模型，再產生混淆矩陣。

cues.en: And you'll see in this case we've got far fewer false positives and we've only lost out on one true positive.
cues.zh: 這時可以看到，偽陽性少了很多，而真陽性只少了一筆。

cues.en: So from 45 fraudulent customers or transactions that we've detected, we've now dropped that to only 44.
cues.zh: 原本偵測到 45 名詐欺客戶或詐欺交易，現在只減少為 44 筆。

cues.en: So you can see this is probably a much more.
cues.zh: 因此，這或許是更

cues.en: I guess, useful representation.
cues.zh: 實用的結果。

cues.en: This is a much better picture.
cues.zh: 整體表現更理想。

cues.en: It's more reasonable, you know, if we're happy to to lose one, but drop 700 odd false positives, I think that's a good place to be from an organizational perspective.
cues.zh: 如果願意少抓到一筆詐欺，卻能減少 700 多筆偽陽性，從組織的角度看，我認為這是合理的取捨。
